title: Find the average view count of posts that are tagged with 'machine-learning
question: Find the average view count of posts that are tagged with 'machine-learning' and have at least one child post with a score greater than 10. Also, return the display name of the user who owns the highest-scoring such child post.

prediction.sql:
WITH tagged_posts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT p.XCL_026 AS post_id, p.XCL_030 AS view_count
    FROM posts AS p
    INNER JOIN tags AS t ON t.XCL_050 = p.XCL_026
    WHERE t.XCL_048 = 'machine-learning'
),
qualified_parents AS (
    SELECT tp.post_id, tp.view_count
    FROM tagged_posts AS tp
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM posts AS c
        WHERE c.XCL_043 = tp.post_id
          AND c.XCL_031 > 10
    )
),
highest_scoring_child AS (
    SELECT u.XCL_055 AS display_name
    FROM posts AS c
    INNER JOIN users AS u ON u.XCL_052 = c.XCL_033
    WHERE c.XCL_043 IN (SELECT post_id FROM qualified_parents)
      AND c.XCL_031 > 10
    ORDER BY c.XCL_031 DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 
    AVG(qp.view_count) AS average_view_count,
    hsc.display_name AS highest_scoring_child_owner
FROM qualified_parents AS qp
CROSS JOIN highest_scoring_child AS hsc

),

    WHERE EXISTS (

        WHERE c.XCL_043 = tp.post_id
          AND c.XCL_031 > 10

),
highest_scoring_child AS (
    SELECT u.XCL_055 AS display_name
    FROM posts AS c
    INNER JOIN users AS u ON u.XCL_052 = c.XCL_033
    WHERE c.XCL_043 IN (SELECT post_id FROM qualified_parents)
      AND c.XCL_031 > 10
    ORDER BY c.XCL_031 DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 
    AVG(qp.view_count) AS average_view_count,
    hsc.display_name AS highest_scoring_child_owner
FROM qualified_parents AS qp
CROSS JOIN highest_scoring_child AS hsc

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT AVG(p.XCL_030) AS avg_views, u.XCL_055 AS display_name
FROM posts p
JOIN tags t ON t.XCL_050 = p.XCL_026 AND t.XCL_048 = 'machine-learning'
JOIN (
  SELECT c2.XCL_033 AS uid
  FROM posts p2
  JOIN tags t2 ON t2.XCL_050 = p2.XCL_026 AND t2.XCL_048 = 'machine-learning'
  JOIN posts c2 ON c2.XCL_043 = p2.XCL_026
  WHERE c2.XCL_031 > 10
  ORDER BY c2.XCL_031 DESC
  LIMIT 1
) top ON 1=1
JOIN users u ON u.XCL_052 = top.uid
WHERE EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM posts c
  WHERE c.XCL_043 = p.XCL_026 AND c.XCL_031 > 10
)
